name: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme For The Scheduled Castes
benefit:
The scheme provides guarantee cover for Working Capital Loans, Term Loans, and Composite Term Loans extended to eligible Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should establish, promote, and operate an enterprise, project, or unit in the primary, manufacturing, or service sector resulting in asset creation. 1. The applicant should be a Scheduled Caste entrepreneur, company, partnership firm, society, sole proprietorship firm, or individual entrepreneur as specified under the scheme. 1. The applicant should have more than 51% ownership and management control held by Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs, promoters, partners, or members. 1. The applicant should maintain Scheduled Caste ownership and control above 51% throughout the currency of the loan. 1. The applicant should provide documentary proof of Scheduled Caste status. 1. The applicant may operate under any Central Government or State Government subsidy or grant scheme. 1. Preference is given to Scheduled Caste-promoted companies over registered partnership firms and registered societies.
